latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release – assists in selecting the optimal web presentation patterns for enterprise applications.

- Guides users through choosing appropriate view and controller patterns (Template View, Transform View, Two Step View, Page Controller, Front Controller, Application Controller) based on their tech stack and pain points.
- Audits designs or codebases for common anti-patterns like fat controllers and scriptlet-heavy templates.
- Maps legacy patterns (JSP, ERB, ASP) to modern equivalents across major frameworks (Spring MVC, Rails, Django, etc.).
- Supports enterprise server-side applications and works with code or description-only input.
- Produces a design record summarizing pattern selections and tailored implementation notes.
